title: Existence of a maximum flow in every network
statement: Every network $N$ on a finite vertex set admits a maximum flow: there exists a flow $f$ in $N$ such that $\mathrm{val}(f') \le \mathrm{val}(f)$ for every flow $f'$ in $N$.
hypotheses_covered: N is a network (finite vertex type)
replaced: \textbf{Existence of a maximum flow} (assumed silently by the book).
